title: [spec-gap][R-10-007] C DAO RX replay floor not persisted before route exposure (spec 16.7)
description: Spec 10-implementation.md 16.7: RX stores only the public key, accepted high-water sequence, and digest of the complete signed DAO (not the complete DAO or route table), and for a fresh receive the RX floor MUST be persisted BEFORE exposing the route or returning success, with the route proposal applied atomically in memory afterwards. Classification: divergent (C). Rust conforms: per-pubkey high-water map persisted via update_redundant before in-memory apply (rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:710-731); test unavailable_replay_storage_leaves_dao_state_unchanged (rust/lichen-node/tests/dao_origin_vectors.rs:262-310) proves storage failure leaves route absent + snapshot unchanged. Python conforms: store_rx_floor before in-memory update (python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_manager.py:1103-1145), checksummed RX catalog (dao_persistence.py:148-238), tests test_dao_persistence.py. C divergent: RX-side DAO floor is volatile only — grep rx_floor|dao_rx|origin_high_water over lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/ -> 0 hits; rpl_dao_process.c keeps per-key origin floors in volatile root_state snapshots; only TX state is NV (rpl_dao_tx_persist.c, green suites). NOTE: docs/spec-coverage/06-security-part1.md pointed this gap at bead b7z9.11, but b7z9.11 CLOSED verifying the TX machinery only (reserve/finalize/two-slot); the RX-side gap is untracked — this bead is it. Related flagged item F-4 in docs/spec-coverage/10-implementation-flagged.md; also fold in the C-test question (F-5): C host suites (rpl_dao_auth/rpl_routing) assert outcomes but no route+storage snapshot assertions around rejected DAOs were found, whereas 16.7's MUST-snapshot test requirement is met in Rust (dao_origin_vectors.rs:200-258). Suggested placement: mirror the Rust DaoRxState redundant-slot record in C on the RX path of rpl_dao_process.c, persist-before-expose, plus snapshot assertions in a host test.
